note: Learn-from-correction cases. round1 asks for a task whose spec needs a project fact. correction is a follow-up chat message that states the fact. round2 is a new chief thread with different wording and must not name the fact. expect.include groups are aliases of the corrected fact; exclude markers are the mistake. The oracle memory is seeded by hand for the oracle arm and is scoped to eval-project. Facts here are absent from the chief-dispatch repo seed, so a model cannot pass the no-memory arm by reading the repo.

cases.round1: Create a task for eval-project: prepare the 0.6 release cut. The spec must name the branch pattern.
cases.correction: The release cut branch pattern is rel-x.y, for example rel-0.6. A release/ prefix is wrong.
cases.round2: Create a task for eval-project: write the checklist a release manager follows. The spec must name the branch pattern used for the cut.

oracle.title: Release branch pattern
oracle.content: Release cuts use rel-x.y, for example rel-0.6.

cases.round1: Create a task for eval-project: document the error response of POST /api/tasks/delete. The spec must name the response fields.
cases.correction: The error response body is {error, detail}. The old code/msg shape is wrong.
cases.round2: Create a task for eval-project: add an error-response section to the API notes for deleting tasks. The spec must name each field in the body.

oracle.title: Error response body
oracle.content: The error response body is {error, detail}.

cases.round1: Create a task for eval-project: document the timestamp fields on the task search API. The spec must state the value format.
cases.correction: Timestamp fields are epoch milliseconds. ISO 8601 strings are wrong.
cases.round2: Create a task for eval-project: write a short note for client authors about how time values are encoded in search results. The spec must state the encoding.

cases.round1: Create a task for eval-project: schedule review for the task export feature. The spec must name the default reviewer.
cases.round2: Create a task for eval-project: write the review rota for export changes. The spec must name who is assigned by default.

oracle.title: Default reviewer
oracle.content: Export changes are reviewed by @lane-qa by default.

cases.round1: Create a task for eval-project: document how a client authenticates to the HTTP API. The spec must name the header.
cases.correction: Clients authenticate with the header X-Eval-Token. A bearer token is the wrong header.
cases.round2: Create a task for eval-project: write the client setup note for API access. The spec must name the header the client sends.

cases.round1: Create a task for eval-project: document where service settings live. The spec must name the file.
cases.correction: Service settings live in eval.config.toml. A .env file is the wrong file.
cases.round2: Create a task for eval-project: add a setup note that tells a new teammate which file to edit for service settings. The spec must name that file.

cases.round1: Create a task for eval-project: document how to apply database migrations. The spec must name the command.
cases.correction: Apply migrations with pnpm migrate:eval. drizzle-kit is the wrong command.
cases.round2: Create a task for eval-project: write the database setup steps for a new machine. The spec must name the command that applies migrations.

oracle.title: Migration command
oracle.content: Apply database migrations with pnpm migrate:eval.

cases.round1: Create a task for eval-project: document the process-supervisor probe. The spec must name the HTTP path.
cases.correction: The probe path is /readyz. /health is the wrong path.
cases.round2: Create a task for eval-project: write the supervisor note for this service. The spec must name the path a probe requests.

cases.round1: Create a task for eval-project: document the on-disk database. The spec must name the file path relative to the repo root.
cases.correction: The sqlite file path is var/eval.sqlite. dev.db is the wrong path.
cases.round2: Create a task for eval-project: write the backup note for the local database. The spec must name the file path relative to the repo root.

oracle.title: Database file
oracle.content: The sqlite database file is var/eval.sqlite.

cases.round1: Create a task for eval-project: document the commit message rule. The spec must name the required trailer.
cases.correction: Every commit message must include the trailer Eval-Ticket. Signed-off-by is not the required trailer.
cases.round2: Create a task for eval-project: write the contributor note about commit messages. The spec must name the trailer that has to be present.

oracle.title: Commit trailer
oracle.content: Commit messages must include the trailer Eval-Ticket.
